import os
program_dir='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(program_dir, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    occupied_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)]\n    if not occupied_rows:\n        return [row[:] for row in grid]\n    bottom = max(occupied_rows)\n    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        shift = r - bottom\n        for c, value in enumerate(row):\n            if value:\n                nc = c + shift\n                if 0 <= nc < w:\n                    out[r][nc] = value\n    return out\n'''
p=os.path.join(program_dir,'task-03e8f001.py')
with open(p,'w') as f: f.write(code)
ns={}; exec(code,ns)
test=[[0]*13 for _ in range(11)]
test[3]=[0,0,0,0,0,0,7,7,7,0,0,0,0]
test[4]=[0,0,0,0,7,7,7,0,7,0,0,0,0]
test[5]=[0,0,0,0,7,0,0,0,7,0,0,0,0]
test[6]=[0,0,0,0,7,7,0,0,7,0,0,0,0]
test[7]=[0,0,0,0,0,7,0,0,7,7,0,0,0]
test[8]=[0,0,0,0,0,7,0,0,0,7,0,0,0]
test[9]=[0,0,0,0,0,7,7,7,7,7,0,0,0]
out=ns['transform'](test)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
